headline.en: UNI up 24.83% weekly on v4 fee-activation catalyst, but still net-inflationary and below the DAO's own $5.96 fair-value mark.
headline.zh: UNI 周涨 24.83%,由 v4 费用激活预期驱动,但仍处于净通胀,且低于 DAO 自定的 $5.96 公允价锚。

keyChanges.en: Price +24.83% 7d to $4.04, reclaiming the floor of the $4-7 institutional accumulation zone but still 32.2% below the $5.96 treasury-burn anchor.
keyChanges.zh: 价格 7 日 +24.83% 至 $4.04,重回 $4-7 机构累积区下沿,但较国库销毁锚 $5.96 仍低 32.2%。

keyChanges.en: Two live governance Temp Checks — Activate v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — the first real fee-base expansion attempt since UNIfication.
keyChanges.zh: 两个正在推进的治理 Temp Check:激活 v4 协议费用、扩展至 Robinhood Chain,是 UNIfication 后首次实质性的费用基数扩张尝试。

keyChanges.en: Still net inflationary at +1.71%/yr: $11.72M annualized buyback burns only 2.9M UNI against 20M in emissions, a 17.1M UNI net-supply overhang.
keyChanges.zh: 仍净通胀 +1.71%/年:年化 $11.72M buyback 仅销毁 2.9M UNI,对应 20M 排放量,净供给缺口 17.1M UNI。

contrarianObservation.en: Temp Check ≠ execution. Uniswap governance has debated fee activation since 2022 without shipping. Until v4 fees actually turn on, the math stays ~55K UNI issued vs ~8K burned daily — this rally is pricing optionality the DAO has repeatedly failed to deliver.
contrarianObservation.zh: Temp Check 不等于执行。Uniswap 治理自 2022 年反复讨论费用激活但从未落地。v4 费用真正开启前,每日仍是约 55K UNI 发行对约 8K 销毁——当前涨幅是在给一个治理层多次辜负过的期权定价。

watchNext.en: Activate v4 Protocol Fees Temp Check — turnout and delegate lineup. Pass with strong turnout doubles the buyback base; quiet failure invalidates the rally thesis.
watchNext.zh: 关注「激活 v4 协议费用」Temp Check 的投票率与代理阵容。高参与度通过将使 buyback 基数翻倍;无声否决则证伪本轮上涨逻辑。

watchNext.en: UNI/ETH ratio at 0.001658 — needs to reclaim ~0.0018 to confirm alt-relative strength rather than a beta bounce inside 59.5% BTC dominance.
watchNext.zh: UNI/ETH 比价 0.001658——需重回约 0.0018 以确认为 UNI 独立强势,而非 BTC 主导 59.5% 环境下的 beta 反弹。

watchNext.en: Perp OI ($22M) and funding (+0.01%). If OI doubles with funding >0.05% before governance ships, positioning becomes the risk instead of fundamentals.
watchNext.zh: 合约 OI($22M)与资金费率(+0.01%)。若治理落地前 OI 翻倍且资金费率 >0.05%,主要风险将从基本面转为持仓拥挤。

fullReasoning.en: UNI is up 24.83% on the week and 8.63% today with almost no perp participation: OI at $22M against a $2.51B market cap and funding at +0.01%. That's a spot-led move, not a leveraged squeeze, which makes it structurally more durable. The catalyst is two live governance Temp Checks — activating v4 protocol fees and extending the fee switch to the Robinhood Chain. Both matter because they attack the exact problem anchoring UNI: at $68.95M annualized revenue and a $11.72M buyback budget, UNI still nets +1.71% inflation per year against 20M in emissions. Expanding the fee-capture base is the only path to flipping net-deflationary short of redesigning the fee switch itself. Price at $4.04 sits at the floor of the $4-7 institutional accumulation zone and 32% below the $5.96 treasury-burn mark — the number the DAO itself stamped as fair value. TVL up 5.90% on the week confirms organic activity rather than pure token reflexivity. Directional call is bullish over 1-4 weeks, but confidence is medium not high: the entire thesis depends on Temp Checks converting into on-chain votes and passing. Uniswap has discussed fee activation since 2022 without shipping. This time is different only if it actually is.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 本周上涨 24.83%,今日再涨 8.63%,但合约参与度极低:Binance UNIUSDT 未平仓合约仅 $22.11M(市值 $2.51B),资金费率 +0.01%。这是现货主导的行情,而非杠杆逼空,结构上更具持续性。核心催化是两个正在推进的治理 Temp Check:激活 v4 协议费用,以及将协议费扩展至 Robinhood Chain。这两项直接命中 UNI 当前的结构性痛点:按年化协议收入 $68.95M、buyback 预算 $11.72M(占收入 17%)测算,UNI 每年仍净通胀 +1.71%,净发行 17.1M,20M/年的排放完全压制了销毁效应。扩大费用捕获基数,是在不重构 fee switch 前提下唯一能翻转为通缩的路径。$4.04 的价格正好位于 $4-7 机构累积区间的下沿,较 DAO 国库销毁隐含价 $5.96 仍低 32%,而 $5.96 是协议自己钉下的公允价值锚。TVL 周涨 5.90% 表明有真实活动支撑,而非单纯的 token 反身性。1-4 周方向看多,但置信度 medium 而非 high:整套逻辑取决于 Temp Check 能否转化为链上投票并通过。Uniswap 自 2022 年起反复讨论费用激活但从未落地,这次能否例外是唯一真正的变量。
